recent_en: 5E Resources recorded several director dealings in September 2026, with Independent Non-Executive Director Siow Chin How acquiring shares in the open market. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August 2026, with revenue of MYR 22.165 million and a net loss of MYR 0.397 million. No major directly related news events were noted recently.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Siow Chin How acquired shares in the open market on 2, 9 and 10 September 2026.
risks_en: The company recorded a net loss of MYR 0.397 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 22.165 million with a net loss of MYR 0.397 million, representing a net margin of -1.8%.
